title: A marketing director tests the argument against her own function — 'Overpromising to close a deal is a culture bank withdrawal, even if the Q4 report calls it a win'
summary: Kocsis wrote up what stayed with her: GitLab live-streaming the recovery after an engineer deleted 300GB and every backup failed, the spiritual holding company, Anthropic's trust surviving the FTX stake sale, and Tony's Open Chain. She adds an example the book does not carry, Rune Kvist building audit standards so insurers can price AI risk.
blockquote: Sales and Marketing carry pipeline targets, so remaining incorruptible can feel counterproductive. Overpromising to close a deal is a culture bank withdrawal, even if the Q4 report calls it a win.
